Appeals Process

A member may appeal a denial within 60 days. The clock starts on the date of the denial letter, not the date it was read.

Stages

  1. First review. A benefits analyst who did not decide the original claim re-reads the file.

  2. Second review. The benefits committee meets monthly and decides by majority.

  3. External review. An independent reviewer, binding on the plan.

Timelines

  • Acknowledgement within 5 business days
  • First review decided within 30 days
  • Expedited review within 72 hours where care is urgent

Missing the 60-day window ends the appeal. There is no discretion to extend it.
